sources.finding: Ignition printing has an exact function-name filter.
Code-event and function-event logging preserve source identities; logfile_per_isolate defaults true. log_code_disassemble is intentionally excluded because it has no subject filter.
CodeTracer redirection and optimized/builtin printing are declared here; disassembler-dependent flags require actual retained-binary confirmation.
Filtered bytecode is written to StdoutStream, with a generated-function header and bytecode length, rather than CodeTracer.
Optimized source and native instructions are written through CodeTracer; print_opt_code_filter applies to optimizing functions.
Maglev CodePrint uses CodeTracer when OBJECT_PRINT is enabled; the fallback Print path is an explicit native-capture limitation, not assumed equivalent.
print_code uses an unredirected Print for baseline code, so the capture excludes that flag; baseline identities remain in the code-event log.
Default redirected names include process ID and isolate ID. A caller-specified filename overrides uniqueness and is not used.
CodeTracer opens append per scope and closes at zero depth; its filename buffer has128 bytes. Default short relative names avoid truncating deep artifact paths.
Default log names prefix isolate pointer and process ID; the capture preserves per-isolate naming.
log_code_disassemble would disassemble every logged Code/BytecodeArray, including builtin events. The bounded design does not enable it.
Builtin disassembly applies the native name filter and writes through CodeTracer. Only BigIntDivide* is requested for pi.
Native disassembly includes code kind/compiler, instruction bytes, source positions, deoptimization data, Maglev/TurboFan safepoint tables, handlers and relocations.
Optimization and OSR compilation traces use CodeTracer.
Actual optimized OSR entry uses CodeTracer and, where enabled, logs a function-execution event.
Deoptimization trace paths use CodeTracer.
GC tracing writes to the process output stream and must be retained separately from the derived benchmark output.
GC lines contain the process/isolate prefix, elapsed milliseconds, collector, before/after heap sizes, pooled size, durations and utilization envelope used by the strict splitter.

The division builtins handle zero, numerator-smaller-than-denominator and unit-divisor cases, then call general CppAbsoluteDivAndCanonicalize. Native caller/builtin evidence must distinguish these paths.
The official release source declares V8 13.6.233.17, matching the base version of the saved native13.6.233.17-node.51 observation.

limits: The official release source establishes diagnostic API behavior; it is not a reproducible-build proof for the retained Node executable.
Actual --v8-options, bytecode/code/event content, OSR/deoptimization history and normal output are still unexecuted. The controller cannot promote work semantics automatically.
Ignition/Sparkplug execution must be distinguished from optimized code by the actual event history; absent optimized bodies cannot be invented or replaced with warmup runs.
Complete loaded-runtime dependency qualification is separate from this targeted work capture.
